lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Packing foam. No medicine. Keep going.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Serial plates filed off. Somebody wanted these never to be traced.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Sidearms. Crystal-forged, and the rounds are cut to tear at a Veil. Nobody builds that to hunt ordinary people. These were made for us.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Three signatures on every transfer: the quartermaster who builds them, the broker who sells them, the chief who keeps it quiet. They are inside.

lines.speaker: Perrin
lines.text: Whatever your people offered, the buyer offered more. In crystal.

lines.speaker: Dask
lines.text: Veil-born, in my workshop. Good. I have wanted to see what these do to one of you.

lines.speaker: Dask
lines.text: I build what I am paid to build. Ask Perrin who pays.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: One core. Two more signatures on every transfer.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: Seal it. Nobody walks out of here with a core.

lines.speaker: Perrin
lines.text: The buyer never showed a face. And never needed the guns for themselves. Think about that.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Two. One more and we know all of it.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: Take it. You will not reach the lift.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: That is all three. Forget the depot: get the cores to the cargo lift. I am bringing it down.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: All posts: lock it down. They are carrying the cores.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Lift is coming. Half a minute. Do not let them pull you off it.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Perrin's records are open. The buyer paid in Will-forged crystal. Only one of us could make that.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: There is a recording on the last core. You should hear it.

lines.speaker: Arden (recording)
lines.text: If you are hearing this, you came for the cores yourself. I taught you to finish what you start. The vault. I will not run.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: ...That is Arden. That is your teacher's voice.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: The Houses hunt us with a word and a warrant. I gave the hunted something to shoot back with.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: You still drop your guard after the third cut. I never could fix that.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: Enough. You have grown past me.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: Take the cores. Decide for yourself who should hold them. I did.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: The lift is here. Whatever you decide about Arden, decide it outside.

lines.speaker: Defender
lines.text: Wardens at the lock! Hold them!

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: They stand down when they are beaten. Let them.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: You will not take one of us. Not one.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: Enough! ...You hold back. Wardens never hold back. Who sent you?

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Tell him the truth. We are here because of the ledger.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: Then you know Arden armed us. Do you know who put that ledger in the Houses' hands?

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: ...I did. I filed it with the House court. I thought it would stop the guns, not bring the warrants.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: Then help us leave. Ring the warning bells and the tunnel opens under the chapel. Hurry: wardens do not knock.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Warden signatures at the outer lock. They are already in the yard.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: They hear it. The first of them are on the stairs.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: One more, and every soul in Saltmarch is moving.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: More of them, and a marksman. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: That is all of them. To the chapel: the tunnel door is behind the altar.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: You came. I hoped you would, and hoped you would not.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: A hundred people are on those stairs. Hold this door with me.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: A second squad through the commons. Wardens and a marksman.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: The last of us are in the tunnel. Thank you, whoever you are.

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: Arden Vale. And company. I carry a warrant for the teacher, and a blank line beneath it.

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: Arden taught you well. Arden taught me too, once.

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: Go, then. All of you.

lines.speaker: Crane
lines.text: The warrant named a teacher. By morning it will name the students.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: The tunnel comes down behind us. Walk with me, or do not. Decide for yourselves. You always did.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: There is a way out at the far end of the tunnel. Go with Arden. I will answer to the court.
